title: [WIP] ldap: consume search results one message at a time
body:
The legacy LDAP backend uses ldap_search_s and retains the complete result before delivering entries. Submit an asynchronous search and consume LDAP_MSG_ONE results, delivering and freeing each entry while checking progress and the transfer deadline. Preserve successful and size-limited partial-result handling.

Validation: the Apple OpenLDAP 2.4.28 legacy backend streams approximately 4.2 MB of entries and exits with timeout 28 at about 1.02 seconds when SearchResultDone is withheld. Normal completion and LDAP_SIZELIMIT_EXCEEDED controls both deliver their entry and return success. This bounds aggregate result retention; it does not add a per-BER-message size limit or change synchronous bind behavior. Windows LDAP still needs CI coverage.

Prepared as a draft against upstream master (`b8f71d6e1199701352c498467c17847237d1c43e`). AI-assisted patch, independently reviewed and tested locally. Source-format checks pass; cross-platform CI remains to be reviewed.
